Standard: The air vehicle meets the flight in icing conditions standard as specified in 14 CFR 27.1093, 29.1093, 27.1325, 29.1325, 27.1419, and 29.1419 including the supplemental appendix on icing certification and AW criteria for rotary-wing instrument flight, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2 with airframe ice accretion during and after flight through icing conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle flying qualities in icing conditions as specified in 14 CFR 27.1093, 29.1093, 27.1325, 29.1325, 27.1419, and 29.1419 including the supplemental appendix on icing certification for rotary-wing instrument flight for each air vehicle configuration, loading, and icing conditions within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle handling qualities in icing conditions as specified in 14 CFR 27.1093, 29.1093, 27.1325, 29.1325, 27.1419, and 29.1419 including the supplemental appendix on icing certification for rotary-wing instrument flight for each air vehicle configuration, loading, and icing conditions within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle handling qualities in icing conditions as specified in 14 CFR 27.1093, 29.1093, 27.1325, 29.1325, 27.1419, and 29.1419 including the supplemental appendix on icing certification for rotary-wing instrument flight for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration, loading, and icing conditions within the SFE.
